result.topic_en: Scratch calculations: an algebraic manipulation of quadratic forms in x, y, z (p, q, f) and a squared expression; numerical evaluation of binomial-coefficient quotients and an identity for $2^{p-1}(2^p-1)$ as a sum of factorial quotients; and, on the lower half written upside down, linear relations among quantities a, b, c, e and $\pi_1,\pi_2,\pi_3$.
